title: AI Interview Coach
description: Practice technical interviews with an AI interviewer powered by Groq’s LLM — answer real questions and get instant, adaptive feedback.
features: AI interviewer with real-time feedback on your answers
Difficulty adapts to your responses as you practice
JWT sessions with SQLite persistence — no external database
Installable PWA, plus desktop (Electron) and mobile (Capacitor) builds

caseStudy.problem: Technical interviews are high-stress and require rapid, adaptive, and detailed feedback to help candidates improve, but live mock interviews are expensive, stressful, and hard to schedule.
caseStudy.solution: Developed a serverless, local-friendly React application connected to Node.js backend route controllers that orchestrate Groq's LLM completions API. The interviewer adapts question difficulty dynamically and returns targeted improvements based on transcripts.
features: AI interviewer with real-time feedback on answers
Difficulty adapts to performance as you practice
JWT sessions with SQLite persistence
PWA installable app & desktop/mobile packaging
caseStudy.architecture:
React Frontend [Client PWA]
  ↓ HTTP Requests / CORS
Node.js / Express Server [Routing]
  ↓ JWT Authentication verification
Groq API Inference [LLM prompts pipeline]
  ↓ Returns adaptive question / feedback
SQLite Database [Local file persistence]
caseStudy.contribution: Migrated the application into a React + Vite SPA, implemented JWT token handshakes, constructed relational SQLite schemas, created the interactive mock curl terminal, and optimized layout design tokens.
caseStudy.challenges: Handling native SQLite dependencies (better-sqlite3) in production environments. Resolved by implementing pure-JS JSON file-backed database adaptors for Railway/Vercel server environments.

title: AI-StudyMate
description: AI-powered study assistant combining a learning dashboard, interactive AI chat and built-in interview practice in one installable app.
features: AI study assistant and interactive chat for any topic
Built-in AI interview coach for answer practice
Study dashboard to organize quizzes, notes and history
Installable PWA with service-worker offline caching

caseStudy.problem: Students struggle to centralize learning resources, quizzes, and interview practice across multiple tools, leading to fragmented study patterns and lack of offline accessibility.
caseStudy.solution: Built an consolidated learning dashboard combining interactive AI learning chat, progress-tracking quizzes, and service worker offline caching wrapped inside an installable Progressive Web App (PWA).
features: AI study assistant and chat for any topic
Built-in interview practice loop
Dashboard to organize quizzes and transcripts
Service worker offline caching layer
caseStudy.architecture:
PWA Client Interface (HTML/CSS/JS)
  ↓ offline caching (Service Workers cache)
Node.js / Express REST API
  ↓
OpenAI / Groq API Complete inference
  ↓
Local Storage synchronization
caseStudy.contribution: Integrated responsive layout designs, configured theme parameters, coded the PWA manifest declarations, and optimized network cache routers.
caseStudy.challenges: Synchronizing quiz status and chat histories across page updates without losing context. Resolved using serialized localStorage cache layers.

title: Task Management System
description: Full-stack task management platform with secure JWT authentication, a Node/Express REST API, MongoDB persistence and a responsive glassmorphism dashboard.
features: Secure JWT authentication with bcrypt password encryption
Full task CRUD with priorities, categories, tags and due dates
Search, filter, sort and paginate tasks
Analytics dashboard with dark mode and toast notifications

caseStudy.problem: Teams lack simple, fast, and secure tools to organize tasks, define priorities, and filter schedules, leading to delayed deliveries and poor task visibility.
caseStudy.solution: Architected a responsive Glassmorphism dashboard executing full CRUD operations, secured with bcrypt password encryption and JWT signatures, with search, pagination, and sorting filters.
features: Secure JWT Auth & bcrypt password hashing
Full dashboard CRUD with prioritization sorting
Advanced search, regex filtering, and pagination
Glassmorphism layout with toast alerts
caseStudy.architecture:
React SPA Dashboard (Glassmorphism layout)
  ↓ Secure HTTP Header (JWT token bearer)
Express API server router
  ↓ MongoDB database queries (Mongoose)
MongoDB Cloud Atlas (Cluster persistence)
caseStudy.contribution: Designed the database schema collections, coded JWT token generation pipelines, and built the glassmorphism card layouts.
caseStudy.challenges: Implementing efficient query pagination and search substring matching across dense task lists. Solved with index sorting and MongoDB query operators.
